name: runtime_health_summary
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

execution.description: Execution worker pool health report (e.g. execution_runtime_health output). Non-dict values are treated as {}.

verification.description: Isolated verification worker pool health report. Non-dict values are treated as {}.

healthy.description: True only when both executionHealthy and verificationHealthy are true.

executionHealthy.description: True when execution.healthy is exactly true.

verificationHealthy.description: True when verification.healthy is exactly true.
